name: RHAMNUS CALIFORNICA
key_symptoms: Dizzy full feeling. Heavy bruised sensation; better from pressure. Bursting feeling with every step. Soreness, especially in occiput and vertex, worse, bending over. Dull pain in left temple. Dull aching in frontal region (left), extending backwards and over forehead. Deep, right-sided frontal headache. Twitching eyelids.
Substernal oppression. Tenderness on pressure of right intercostal muscles.
Unable to control muscular action. Legs sore. Walked like a drunken man.
